relationship: New finite mechanism pilot after G16PR2 failed to replicate the LSD-first output-serialization signal. Existing G17W contains only an incomplete loader commit and is not evidence.

hypotheses.H18a: Ordered latent execution-state supervision at four constant workspace markers improves mean arithmetic+code_trace IID free-generation exact by at least 1.0 percentage point over a final-answer-only control across two fixed seeds.
hypotheses.H18b: Chronological workspace targets outperform a parameter- and auxiliary-loss-matched bag-of-states target by at least 0.5 percentage points on arithmetic+code_trace IID exact.
hypotheses.H18c: The ordered workspace arm lowers IID answer-token NLL versus final-only control without more than 2 percentage points memory+list IID regression.

workspace: The prompt contains four constant '~' marker bytes. No gold trace is inserted into the prompt. During training only, an auxiliary head reads hidden states at these marker positions. Ordered arm predicts chronological intermediate integer states; bag arm predicts the same four state values sorted numerically; final-only uses auxiliary weight zero with identical parameters.

semantic_canonicalization.list_reasoning: sort values because sum/min/max are permutation-invariant
semantic_canonicalization.memory_update: canonicalize cross-key interleavings by per-key histories while retaining chronology within each key and exact queried address

training.optimizer: AdamW lr .001 warmup10 cosine-to10%, betas(.9,.95), wd .01, clip1

inference: Greedy free generation from prompt strings only; EOS required; strict F=<integer>; no case object, gold answer, solver, or auxiliary target at inference.
selection: Held sets never select checkpoints or hyperparameters; final step200 only.
scope: Small mechanism pilot only. It cannot establish Qwen parity or the 300-800M target.
external_borrow: No external code, weights, or pretrained base. Backbone mechanism is copied from this FlyGraph repository's G5S/G8C causal hybrid implementation.
